$comment: Corrections to the compatibility data that scripts/bindings/web-availability.mjs reads, for `lasm build --target`'s check (docs/JS_BINDINGS.md, "Availability per target"). Each entry: the API's compatibility path (api.Window.navigator) or Lean name, the runtimes it corrects, `available`, why, a link (the upstream report, or Lasm's evidence), and its decision in docs/api/decisions/0.3.md.

overrides.why: the global navigator: the data records it under api.Navigator for these runtimes (BCD: Node 21; runtime-compat: Bun, workerd), not under Window; js-web conformance reads navigator.userAgent on each
Bun 1.4.4 (Lasm's pinned Bun) constructs File; the data describes Bun 1.3.3
Bun 1.4.4 constructs CompressionStream (the data lists the interface on Bun but not its constructor)
Bun 1.4.4 constructs DecompressionStream (the data lists the interface on Bun but not its constructor)
workerd has MessageChannel and its ports; js-web conformance posts a structured clone through one on workerd (the data lists the interface, not its constructor or members)
the ports of workerd's MessageChannel: js-web conformance posts, receives through onmessage and closes them on workerd
the messages workerd's MessagePort delivers: js-web conformance reads their data, origin and ports on workerd
js-web conformance calls performance.toJSON() on workerd
workerd's TransformStream: js-web conformance enqueues through its controller on workerd
js-web conformance reads URLPattern.hasRegExpGroups on workerd
Bun 1.4.4 (Lasm's pinned Bun) has URLPattern; the data describes Bun 1.3.3. js-web conformance constructs one and calls test and exec and reads its components on Bun
WebAssembly.CompileError (and its message and name, an Error's) is part of every engine's WebAssembly; runtime-compat lists no WebAssembly error classes
Vercel Edge constructs Response (the data lists the interface on edge-light but not its constructor); the fetch template answers with new Response on Vercel Edge
Vercel Edge constructs URL (the data lists the interface on edge-light but not its constructor); the fetch template parses the request URL with new URL on Vercel Edge
